summary: Jürgen Chrobog, former Secretary of State in the German Foreign Office, was abducted today in eastern Yemen along with his wife, their three children and three locals after their vehicle went missing around 460 km east of the capital Sanaá, and the Yemeni interior ministry said they were abducted by a tribal group. Reuters named the captors as members of the Al-Abdullah tribe who told the news agency by phone that the family is not in danger and are their "guests" and that they are demanding the Yemeni government release a member of their tribe from prison; a spokesperson for the German Foreign Office said it is unknown whether Chrobog was singled out. Chrobog was German ambassador to the United States from 1994 till 2001 before transferring to the Foreign Office where he negotiated the release of Germans held abroad, and this is the fourth time this year that foreigners were abducted in the country to blackmail the Yemeni government.
